exposure: psychosocial stress of the mother during pregnancy
shared decision-making regarding medical procedures during the delivery
quality of mother-child and father-child relationship
cohort: 126 participants (aADHD, BD, and healthy controls) and their mothers
finding: Several pre-, peri-, and postnatal risk factors were significantly associated with both aADHD and BD compared to healthy controls, while no significant environment-gene interactions were found.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a significant risk factor for both aADHD and BD.
